text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Stepping into the cafe, Loves Only You 
was surrounded by heaps of food."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"What do you mean? It's the menu 
Trainer-kun came up with for me."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"What do you mean? It's the menu 
Trainer-chan came up with for me."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It keeps a close eye on nutritional 
balance and calories while still being 
thoroughly satisfying—truly impressive!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I once thought about 
managing her diet, but..."
choice_data_list:
That's three meals' worth—breakfast, 
lunch, and dinner!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh--!? I ordered it all at once...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Eating three whole meals might be 
pushing it, right...? But they're all 
things I love..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We'll just be more careful next time, so 
let's eat it this once! If it's food you 
love, won't you digest it faster anyway?
choice_data_list: Quantity Matters Too! Let's Split It Up!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Can't be helped, then let's split it.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But this way, we get to enjoy a little 
bit of all kinds of side dishes!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A relationship of giving and receiving, 
truly just like love! Fufu, this is going 
to be a fun lunch♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yay♡ Today is a cheat day!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Time to dig in and enjoy the lovely menu 
Trainer-kun came up with♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I'll gladly enjoy this love menu you made 
for me, Trainer-chan♪"
